probe_subprocess_timeout.reason: a loaded host turns every timed class into this one

stray_cpu_budget.reason: a loaded host turns the stray verification CPU budget into this one

probe_subprocess_failure.reason: an environment fault, never an accepted class: generation and replay fail on it and print the first stderr line

builder_deadline.reason: no case can sit with margin on both sides of a load-scaled deadline

retired_case_ids.reason: extrapolated cost only 25x the budget at cap 10000; the pinned input now runs at cap 262144 (D-83 item 1: 100x or more)
compiles on Python 3.11 and later (atomic groups), so its class depends on the interpreter (D-95 item 1); no replacement

comparison.pipeline_records: compare only the keys present in each expected record; a runner that cannot observe the engine event bus skips the events key instead of failing it
comparison.events_envelopes: compare only the keys present in each expected envelope (envelopes from different emitter seams carry different key sets); volatile fields are dropped recursively and listed in events_volatile_fields; xfail cases are advisory and carry no expectations

events_prefix_rules.rest: the driver's own error detail, never compared

comparison.redis_interop: byte equality: keys, static string values and TTL semantics are exact; zset members the engine generates at write time (uuid4 hex, epoch floats) and ban expiry floats are pinned by SHAPE (regex), not value; zset scores are compared as floats at 6-decimal precision
comparison.misconfiguration: compare expected.raises exactly, and expected.reported and expected.fatal as sorted multisets of [kind, subject] pairs; the English message is never compared and no case encodes which problem came first. reported is every problem a run with fail_on_misconfiguration=False records, fatal is every error-severity problem the one raise of a run with fail_on_misconfiguration=True carries, so a warn kind is never fatal. With the flag true the engine still logs every warn problem and logs no error problem, so the log of that run equals the warn-severity part of reported. A kind marked fatal_only in the suite kinds block is checked only while the flag is true and so appears in fatal and never in reported. A runner that does not implement a kind lists it as deferred; a runner meeting a suite kind it does not list as deferred fails closed
comparison.pattern_safety_records: compare expected.safe and expected.reason_class; the numeric parts of over-budget reason strings are host-measured and never compared; a runner whose safety chain cannot produce a reason_class yet maps the case to that class's documented divergence instead of failing silently

cost_budgets.method: ceilings are self-relative so they survive host variance: a runner measures its own best-of-3 at the 8 KiB workload (cost_prose_8kib) and every other workload must satisfy best_ms <= K * best8_ms * (size_bytes / 8192) + floor_ms, with K=5 and floor_ms=250. This catches gross superlinearity while tolerating fixed-overhead and host differences. reference_ms below is the configured reference engine's best-of-5 on the generating host, recorded for drift review only, never compared. Verdicts in this suite compare exactly like every other suite.
